mapper.sql: environment, name, value, secret, enabled, description, sort_order, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM env_variables WHERE environment = #{environment} AND name = #{name}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO env_variables (environment, name, value, secret, enabled, description, sort_order) VALUES (#{environment}, #{name}, #{value}, #{secret}, #{enabled}, #{description}, #{sortOrder}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE value = VALUES(value), secret = VALUES(secret), enabled = VALUES(enabled), description = VALUES(description), sort_order = VALUES(sort_order)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM env_variables WHERE environment = #{environment} AND name = #{name}
